subject: FOREIGN MILITARY PRESENCE — JOINT EXPEDITIONARY FORCE (JEF) INTEGRATION
target: Canadian Armed Forces Installations / DND Command
summary: Integration of multinational JEF components and external strategic forces onto domestic Canadian bases without transparent civilian operational oversight.
key_findings: Canadian military infrastructure has actively integrated foreign force elements under the guise of the Joint Expeditionary Force (JEF) and allied interoperability, functionally bypassing parliamentary debate on foreign troop presence.
While officially designated for 'expeditionary' (overseas) readiness, elements of foreign command structures dictate operational tempo within domestic bases.

CFNIS (Military Police) structurally prioritize protecting mult-national command agreements over investigating domestic intelligence bleed, actively punishing Canadian whistleblowers who report foreign penetration (e.g. MWO Robar leak, NML Winnipeg).

legal_implications.criminal_code_50: Assisting alien enemies to leave Canada, or omitting to prevent treason. When foreign intelligence assets embedded within these joint forces are identified, the military command's failure to prosecute them domestically constitutes a s.50 violation.
legal_implications.nda_92: Scandalous conduct by exposing Canadian personnel to non-statutory foreign military oversight.
